Data source overview  
The provided “paper” is actually a plain bibliography section: a list of 38 isolated citations (books, reports, news articles, academic papers).  No prose, arguments, methods, findings, or interventions are given—only reference metadata (authors, titles, outlets, dates).  Because there is no substantive content, there are no explicit or even implicit causal-interventional reasoning chains that can be extracted into the required knowledge-fabric structure.

Why no compliant extraction is possible  
1. All mandatory node categories (risk → … → validation evidence) require explicit statements of problems, analyses, insights, design rationales, mechanisms, findings, etc.  The reference list contains none of these.  
2. Even moderate inference is infeasible: without sentences describing what any reference claims, we cannot safely guess the substance of each work without importing knowledge from outside the supplied data source, which the instructions prohibit.  
3. Consequently, every required pathway would be purely speculative, violating the edge-confidence criteria (would be “0” rather than even “1”) and the instruction against fabricating content.

Instruction-set improvement suggestions  
• Include at least the abstract, introduction, conclusion, or executive summary of the source so that claims, evidence, and proposed interventions can be identified.  
• If only references are provided, allow cross-referencing publicly available abstracts or permit light external knowledge to summarise each cited work; otherwise extraction is impossible.  
• Provide guidance on how to handle purely bibliographic sources—e.g. skip extraction and log a metadata-only entry—so the pipeline can proceed without manual intervention.

Inference strategy justification  
Not applicable: inference could not be responsibly applied without violating the “use only the provided data source” rule.

Extraction completeness explanation  
No nodes or edges are output because none can be grounded in the data source.  Outputting an empty fabric is therefore the only faithful, instruction-compliant result.

Key limitations  
• The pipeline currently cannot process bibliography-only inputs.  
• Downstream stages will need a mechanism to recognise and bypass such inputs automatically.

EXTRACTION CONFIDENCE[92]

JSON structure (empty fabric):

```json
{
  "nodes": [],
  "edges": []
}
```
